notes.note: Reviewed integration of foundation 15624e4ddbe with the Lite publisher repairs. Wire batches, probes and Full outbox records use the data inventory revision; acknowledgement receipts use the separately wording-bound revision. Both publishers reject Full acknowledgement under DNT. Publisher-specific consent, the completed-day sender, pre-launch CLI notice decision, action-bound feedback and local ledger bounds are preserved. The affected service, route, contract, receiver, privacy and disclosure UI test owners were executed; the runtime fixture now supplies the publisher status required by the DNT guard. Other cited process, authority, storage, accounting and provider paths are unchanged; no new deployment or release claim is made.
